note: The OLG comprehensively covers FNS 1022's self-employment requirements. All major self-employment types listed by FNS are addressed: farming/ranching (Migrant Farm Laborers page + self-employment averaging examples for farmers), rental property with the specific 20-hour/week active management threshold (Types of Earned Income page states 'Income from rental property is counted as earned self-employment income only if a household member actively engages in the management of the property for an average of at least 20 hours per week'), roomer/boarder income (dedicated 'Rental, Roomer, and Boarder Income SNAP' page with definitions, examples, and expense treatment), and independent contracting/gig work (1099 Income section with specific Uber/Lyft examples). The OLG also covers self-employment determination criteria via a detailed comparison table (Self-Employment Determination), income averaging and annualization for seasonal/variable self-employment income, and the special rule that cash-paid workers with no business expenses are NOT self-employed. The BEACON procedures for entering rental income as earned vs. unearned based on the 20-hour threshold are also documented in the ABAWD Work Rules Participation page.
